scope: Local regtest-only walletless native owner signer; no production-readiness or other-platform claim.

build.source_state: Uncommitted signer changes plus concurrent native test RPC/refactor changes. Source hashes identify signer inputs; binary hashes are observed files, not reproducible-build proof.

python_tests.command: SHAREPOOL_SIGNER_BINARY=<built signer> python3 -B -m unittest test_native_signer test_native_enforcement
python_tests.evidence: Successful tool-runner output; includes disposable random native keys, canonical bytes, true signature verification, native policy mismatch rejection, mode/symlink/hardlink/FIFO checks, macOS ACL rejection and inheritance removal, exclusive creation, subprocess output bounds and timeouts.

limits: Offline owner/round authorization does not verify native tip, entire template or snapshot completeness.
Signer uses unencrypted mode0600 local key files; trusted private directory and host required.
No private key import, remote signing service, HSM, wallet or production provisioning/recovery.
POSIX executable; tested on macOS arm64 only.
